mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, project_id, benchmark_id, name, model_version_ids::text AS model_version_ids, status, progress, config::text AS config, started_at, completed_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_task (tenant_id, project_id, benchmark_id, name, model_version_ids, status, progress, config, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{benchmarkId}, #{name}, CAST(#{modelVersionIds} AS JSONB), COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending'), COALESCE(#{progress}, 0), CAST(#{config} AS JSONB), #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM evaluation_task WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_task SET status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, started_at = #{startedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM evaluation_task WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
